body: Verify the eight local assignments; acyclic propagation gives a unique tree encoding. An internal flag belongs to a producing gate and consuming gate, two neighbours each. NAND uses pAND(a,b,1-c); COPY uses(a-b)^2, with circuit fanout/routing separately paid. The one-flag restriction follows because the y=0 energy would vanish everywhere except1^m and hence have multilinear degree m, contradicting degree<=2. Given an ideal W and frozen input memory, the field sees only selected r1 or off r0; conjugating by W and its inverse preserves the full wavepacket/reference error. For all-N reuse, flags must have the declared charge grammar and compatible joint zero states; no arbitrary memory T or charge convention is silently imported. Detailed missing general-compiler and pulse results remain source-only.
